newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's net int'l reserves $8.793 bln on Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: Peru's net int'l reserves $8.793 bln on Jan 8.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank said Monday its net international reserves rose to $8.793 billion on January 8 from $8.540 billion at the end of 1996.
The bank's foreign exchange position, or total liquidity minus short and long-term debt obligations, was $1.720 billion on January 8, the bank added in a report.
President Alberto Fujimori said recently the government expected Peru's international reserves to rise above $10 billion by mid-1998.
